title: NPSolver: Neural Poisson Solver with Iterative Physics Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2605.25786v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficiently solving Poisson equations on complex, irregular domains remains a fundamental challenge in scientific computing, as classical iterative solvers often suffer from prohibitive runtime due to ill-conditioned systems. While neural operators offer a fast alternative, they typically rely on large-scale labeled datasets or struggle with unstable training dynamics when using physics-informed residual losses. We propose \textsc{NPSolver}, a neural Poisson solver trained without solution labels via iterative physics supervision. Instead of relying on fully converged numerical solutions or raw PDE residuals, \textsc{NPSolver} utilizes a small number of preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) steps to refine its own predictions, providing a more stable and well-scaled training signal. translated_title: NPSolver：基于迭代物理监督的神经泊松求解器
translated_abstract: 在复杂、不规则区域上高效求解泊松方程仍然是科学计算中的一项根本性挑战，因为传统迭代求解器常因系统病态而导致运行时间过长。虽然神经算子提供了一种快速的替代方案，但它们通常依赖于大规模标注数据集，或者在使用物理信息残差损失时面临训练动态不稳定的问题。我们提出了 NPSolver，一种通过迭代物理监督、无需解标签进行训练的神经泊松求解器。NPSolver 既不依赖完全收敛的数值解，也不使用原始 PDE 残差，而是利用少量预条件共轭梯度（PCG）迭代步来精炼其自身的预测，从而提供更稳定、尺度更合适的训练信号。理论分析证实，这种迭代监督充当了一个条件良好的误差代理，并且停止梯度设计是必不可少的。
tldr: NPSolver 提出了一种无需解标签的神经泊松求解器，通过少量预条件共轭梯度（PCG）迭代步精炼自身预测作为迭代物理监督，获得了比原始 PDE 残差更稳定、尺度更合适的训练信号。
en_tdlr: NPSolver is a neural Poisson solver trained without solution labels, which uses a small number of preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) steps to refine its own predictions as iterative physics supervision, yielding a more stable and well-scaled training signal than raw PDE residuals.
